crossRefs.note: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,
All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.
One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.
For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and streams on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your descendants…
Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children and am…
“Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth; break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child: for…
“Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from…
“Before she travailed, she gave birth. Before her pain came, she delivered a son.
For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by…
But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;
For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will…
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

translations.web: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
translations.bsb: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn— all that He has done.
translations.kjv: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done
translations.asv: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it. Psalm 23 A Psalm of David.
